sections.content: You know *te recomiendo que* + subjunctive from B1 Unit 7 and *es importante que* + subjunctive from A2 Unit 27. Here you use them to recommend films, books and music: *recomendar que*, *aconsejar que* and *es importante que* are followed by the present subjunctive (*veas*, *escuches*, *leas*), and so is *merecer que*.

items.spanish: Te recomiendo que veas esta película.
items.english: I recommend that you watch this film.

items.spanish: Es importante que leas la novela antes de ver la película.
items.english: It is important that you read the novel before watching the film.

items.spanish: Te aconsejo que escuches la canción.
items.english: I advise you to listen to the song.

items.spanish: La obra merece que la conozcas mejor.
items.english: The work deserves for you to get to know it better.

sections.content: The person who recommends and the person who acts are different: *Yo te recomiendo que tú leas esta novela.* If you say what you yourself will do, use the infinitive: *Voy a leer esta novela.*
